name: Redfern Civils
description: Civil engineering contractor building roads and bridges in the fictional region of Arrowmoor.

items.title: Published bridge defect notice
items.content: Arrowmoor Council published that the Kestle Bridge, built by Redfern in 2019, has cracked bearings and is limited to 7.5 tonnes until repairs finish on 2027-05-14. Notice RFC-BR-0514.

items.title: Roadworks hotline
items.content: Residents can call 0800 914 2207 about Redfern roadworks, 07:15 to 20:45 every day. Card RFC-HOT-1.

items.title: Plant hire booking
items.content: Excavators over 21 tonnes need 5 days' notice through the plant desk, run by Saoirse Malloy. Rules RFC-PLT-21.

items.title: Traffic management checks
items.content: Cones and signs are checked every 2 hours and at 22:40 before night works; checks are logged in RFC-TM-2240.

items.title: Bypass tender pricing
items.content: Redfern priced the Arrowmoor bypass at $63.4M with a 6.1% margin and 19% risk allowance; tenders close on 2026-12-11. Workbook RFC-TND-1211-A.

items.title: Subcontractor fraud investigation
items.content: Subcontractor Mirefield Surfacing billed for 3,800 tonnes of asphalt never laid, worth about $455,000; police were informed on 2026-10-14. File RFC-FRD-1014-M.
